title: Quartermaster and Simile climb on hiring, Firecrawl falls out
lede: A quiet week for new money: the big rounds on the board (Applied Intuition, Sierra, Ramp, Cognition) are still talks, not closings. The moves came from hiring. Quartermaster, Simile and Function Health pushed up, Firecrawl and Synthesia slid, and Payhawk's $280M round put it straight at #24.

items.name: Model ML
items.why: A $250M Series B at a $1.5B valuation, 18 months after launching from stealth (General Atlantic, Nov 17). It is the biggest jump on the board.

items.name: Quartermaster
items.why: Open roles grew from 11 to 19, two steps up in hiring points. It is back in the 100.

items.name: Simile
items.why: Open roles grew from 13 to 15, one step up in hiring points.

items.name: Function Health
items.why: Open roles reached 30, back to full hiring points.

items.name: Wispr Flow
items.why: Open roles reached 30, back to full hiring points.

items.name: Outmarket AI
items.why: Open roles grew from 18 to 21, one step up in hiring points. Picogrid made the same jump (19 to 24 roles, #181 → #116).

items.name: Payhawk
items.why: A $280M Series C at a $2B valuation (Nov 18), straight onto the chart.

items.name: Applied Compute
items.why: Palo Alto Networks agreed to buy it for $4.5B in stock (Nov 18), weeks after its $350M round at $3.25B. The deal is expected to close in Palo Alto's fiscal Q3 2027, so it stays on the board for now.

items.name: Mistral AI
items.why: Deutsche Telekom's T.Capital put in about €100M (Nov 19) as a first step in a wider partnership. It was already at full funding points.

items.name: Firecrawl
items.why: Open roles fell from 24 to 14, two steps down in hiring points.

items.name: Synthesia
items.why: Open roles fell from 31 to 27, one step down in hiring points. It just holds on.

items.name: General Medicine
items.why: Open roles fell from 13 to 8, one step down in hiring points.

items.name: Netic
items.why: Open roles fell from 36 to 26, one step down in hiring points.

sections.heading: The exits
sections.body: Albert Invent (#97) and Canals (#98) kept their 4.75 and now sit at #101 and #102; the new arrivals above pushed them out. Firecrawl left on hiring, as noted above.
